name: Trondheim
author: rslurry
description:
Uses 250m x 250m population and job data from Statistisk sentralbyrå.  Covers the greater Trondheim area.  Special demand:

Airports: TRD

Universities: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU - Gløshaugen, Dragvoll, and Øya campuses), Queen Maud University College (DMMH), BI Norwegian Business School, NORD University

Entertainment: Nidarosdomen, Kristiansten Festning, Gamle bybro, Rockheim, Ringve Music Museum, Sverresborg Trøndelag Folk Museum, Stiftsgården, Archbishop's Palace, NTNU Ringve Botanical Garden, Pirbadet, Bymarka, Korsvika, Solsiden Senter, Munkholmen, Our Lady Church, Trondheim Kunstmuseum, Vitensenteret
